title: Oliver's Textures
description: Texture pack that may or may not be cursed.
body:
Oliver’s Textures is a resource pack that overhauls a large portion of Minecraft’s visuals while introducing a selection of intentionally unusual and “cursed” textures.

The pack aims to provide a mix of redesigned assets and unexpected visual changes, creating a different experience from vanilla Minecraft without following a strictly consistent style.

# **Overview**
Texture changes across most blocks/items
Not the most consistent artstyle but ehh its fine


# **Compatibility**
Intended for recent versions of Minecraft
May function on older versions (1.20 and before) , though some textures may not display correctly or may just not work entirely


# **Notes**

This resource pack includes intentionally strange or unexpected visuals. It is not designed for players seeking a purely polished or vanilla-style experience.
